title: 理发与预约

words.example: This salon is close to my office.
I'd like to book an appointment for Saturday.
Just a trim, not too short.
Can you cut my bangs a little?
The stylist is with another client.
Do you want a wash first?

scenarios.title: 电话预约理发
scenarios.setting: 周六你想去附近美发店理发，先打电话问能不能预约。

lines.en: Hi, I'd like to book an appointment for Saturday.
lines.speak: Hi, I'd like to book an appointment for Saturday.

lines.en: Afternoon, please. I'd like a haircut.
lines.speak: Afternoon, please. I'd like a haircut.

lines.en: We have a stylist at three. It will take about forty minutes.
lines.zh: 三点有造型师。大概需要四十分钟。
lines.speak: We have a stylist at three. It will take about forty minutes.

scenarios.title: 到店说明怎么剪
scenarios.setting: 你没预约直接进店，向造型师说明只想修一修，刘海剪短一点。

lines.zh: 你好，不预约直接剪可以吗？

lines.en: Yes, I can take you now. Do you want a wash first?
lines.zh: 可以，现在就能剪。要先洗头吗？
lines.speak: Yes, I can take you now. Do you want a wash first?

lines.en: Yes, please. Just a trim, not too short.
lines.zh: 要的。稍微修一下，别剪太短。
lines.speak: Yes, please. Just a trim, not too short.

lines.en: Can you cut my bangs a little?
lines.speak: Can you cut my bangs a little?

task: 把上面预约和到店说明的句子连着说一遍，录下来自己听
